title: Welsh Rarebit Steak with Crispy Kissed British Bites
description: A twist on the classic Welsh dish, this Japanese-inspired recipe features crispy Kissed British bites, served on top of a rare steak with a rich Welsh Rarebit sauce.
instructions: 1. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season steak with salt, pepper, and sugar.
3. Grill steak to desired doneness, about 5-7 minutes per side for medium-rare.
4. Meanwhile, toast Kissed British Buns on grill or in toaster.
5. In a small saucepan, whisk together Welsh Rarebit Cheese Sauce Mix, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
6. Bring sauce to a simmer over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
7. Stir in crispy shallots and sesame oil.
8. To assemble, place grilled steak on toasted Kissed British Buns, then spoon Welsh Rarebit sauce over top.
9. Serve immediately, garnished with additional crispy shallots if desired.
